design.decision: Overtake with side-suit honors instead of ruffing, and save [♠]s for defense, so it pays for winning tricks in suits.
design.opponent: Shown on the first side-suit win; opponents ruff your team's side honors whenever they can.
design.rationale: This is the broad rare points piece the Suits, Ranks and Rainbow side-suit builds share, at about +135 on a typical round of 4.5 side wins, and it sits against Spades payoffs, so it creates tension between ruffing and cashing. Points are lost on a set, which keeps bids tense.
design.draftText: +30 contract points when your team wins a trick with a card other than [♠]

critic.concerns: Fires on most tricks, so it plays close to a flat bonus; tension against ruffing is real but mild.
